# Lua API reference

<!-- Generated by tools/scripts/lua_api_docs.py markdown from gamedata/tools/lua_api.json. Do not edit: edit the JSON file and run the script. -->

Every function a script can call, by table. The same text is what the in-game Lua editor shows under the cursor ([tools.md](tools.md#lua-editor)); it comes from `gamedata/tools/lua_api.json`, and a mod that adds functions describes them in its own `<mod>/tools/lua_api.json`. How scripts are loaded and what they may do is in [scripting.md](scripting.md).

**Units.** Positions and lengths are Q12 integers (4096 = 1 m, Y grows downwards), angles Q12 (4096 = a full turn), times Q12 seconds, health Q12 (409600 = 100), unless a line says otherwise. A character is its slot number: 0 the player, 1 and up the others. Items, flags, characters, sounds and messages are given by name.

**Coverage.** 1064 functions are listed, 774 of them described. The rest are listed by signature under "Not described yet": they exist and can be called, but nobody has written down what they do; nearly all of them are helpers of the base game's own map and character scripts, and reading those scripts (`gamedata/maps/*/events.lua`, `gamedata/chara/*/behavior.lua`) is the way to learn them. `...` in a signature means the arguments have not been written down either.

## (globals)

Helpers the script hosts define beside the `sh` table, and the Lua library names that exist in the sandbox.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `assert(v[, message]) -> v` | Raises an error when v is false or nil. |
| `error(message[, level])` | Raises an error. |
| `extend(name, function(base, ...) ... end)` | In a mod's layer: wraps the function of that name; base is its definition before this layer. |
| `fmv(param[, complete_flag])` | Plays a movie. |
| `getmetatable(v) -> mt` | The metatable of a value. |
| `ipairs(t) -> iterator` | Iterates over t[1], t[2], ... up to the first nil. |
| `load_map(map, point[, complete_flag])` | Goes through a door to another map the game's usual way (fade, loading screen). |
| `next(t[, key]) -> key, value` | The entry of a table after key. |
| `pairs(t) -> iterator` | Iterates over every key and value of a table. |
| `pcall(f, ...) -> ok, results` | Calls f and catches an error: false and the message instead of raising it. |
| `print(...)` | Writes its arguments to the game log. |
| `say(msg) -> choice` | In a coroutine: shows a map message until it ends; returns the chosen answer. |
| `select(n, ...)` | The arguments from the n-th on; select("#", ...) is their count. |
| `setmetatable(t, mt) -> t` | Sets the metatable of a table. |
| `tonumber(v[, base]) -> number` | Converts a string to a number; nil when it is not one. |
| `tostring(v) -> string` | Converts a value to a string. |
| `type(v) -> name` | The type of a value as a string. |
| `wait(seconds)` | In a coroutine: waits a time in logic ticks (30 per second). |
| `wait_fade()` | In a coroutine: waits until the screen fade has finished. |
| `wait_frames(n)` | In a coroutine: waits n ticks. |
| `wait_until(fn)` | In a coroutine: waits until fn() returns true. |

## math

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `math.abs(x) -> number` | The absolute value. |
| `math.ceil(x) -> integer` | The smallest integer not below x. |
| `math.floor(x) -> integer` | The largest integer not above x. |
| `math.max(x, ...) -> number` | The largest argument. |
| `math.min(x, ...) -> number` | The smallest argument. |
| `math.random([m[, n]]) -> number` | A random number of Lua's own generator (not the game's: see sh.rng). |
| `math.sqrt(x) -> number` | The square root. |
| `math.tointeger(x) -> integer` | x as an integer when it has no fraction, else nil. |

## sh

Flat functions: the vocabulary the base game's map event scripts are written in. Many have a named twin in a table below; new scripts should prefer the named form.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.ambient_sfx()` | Updates the map's ambient sounds. |
| `sh.api_version() -> number` | The version of the script API (3). |
| `sh.background_gamma(q8)` | Sets the brightness of the background picture. |
| `sh.bgm(track)` | Changes the music track. |
| `sh.bgm_status_flags_get() -> flags` | The music status flags. |
| `sh.bgm_status_flags_set(flags)` | Sets the music status flags. |
| `sh.camera_auto_return()` | Gives the camera back to the game's automatic control. |
| `sh.camera_default_speeds() -> xz, y, angle_x, angle_y` | The camera's default speeds. |
| `sh.camera_look(x, y, z, a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, warp)` | The point the event camera looks at: x, y, z in metres, the rest as camera_pos. |
| `sh.camera_pos(x, y, z, a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, warp)` | The event camera's position: x, y, z in metres, a0..a6 the offsets, accelerations and speeds in Q12, warp jumps there at once. |
| `sh.chara_anim(chara, name[, fallback]) -> clip` | A clip of a character's data by name ("anims"). |
| `sh.chara_anim_play_to_end(slot, state)` | Plays the character's clip to its end. |
| `sh.chara_anim_start_keyframe_get(slot)` | The first keyframe of the character's active clip. |
| `sh.chara_anim_unlock_play_to_end(slot)` | Unlocks the character's animation and plays the clip to its end. |
| `sh.chara_field_get(slot, field) -> value` | A field of a character: health, move_speed, fall_speed, control_state, state_step, anim_time, anim_status, anim_keyframe, anim_flags, collision_state, flags, chara_id. |
| `sh.chara_field_set(slot, field, v)` | Writes a field of a character (see chara_field_get). |
| `sh.chara_id(name) -> id` | The number of a character type by its folder name in chara/; nil when unknown. |
| `sh.chara_load(model, chara, force_free)` | Loads a character's model; force_free 255 frees every slot first. |
| `sh.chara_model_clear(slot)` | Clears the model of a character slot. |
| `sh.chara_param(chara, name[, fallback]) -> value` | A parameter of a character's data ("params"). |
| `sh.chara_param_q12(chara, name, fallback) -> value` | A parameter of a character's data as Q12. |
| `sh.chara_process_loads()` | Processes the queued character loads. |
| `sh.chara_props_reset(slot)` | Resets the properties of a character slot. |
| `sh.chara_sfx(chara, slot[, fallback]) -> sound` | A sound of a character's data (the "sounds" slot). |
| `sh.chara_slot_anim_flags_clear(slot, flags)` | Clears animation flags of a character. |
| `sh.chara_slot_anim_flags_set(slot, flags)` | Sets animation flags of a character (slot 0 is the player). |
| `sh.chara_slot_chara_id_get(slot) -> id` | The character type in a slot; -1 when the slot is empty. |
| `sh.chara_slot_control_set(slot, control_state, step)` | Sets the control state of the character in a slot. |
| `sh.chara_slot_transform_get(slot) -> x, y, z, rot_y` | The position and rotation of the character in a slot. |
| `sh.chara_slot_transform_set(slot, x, y, z, rot_y)` | Moves and turns the character in a slot. |
| `sh.chara_spawn(chara, spawn_flags, x, z[, rot[, step]]) -> slot` | Spawns a character at x, z; -1 when it cannot be placed. |
| `sh.chara_spawn_entry_set(entry, on)` | Marks an entry of the map's spawn table as in play, so the map's spawner leaves it alone. |
| `sh.chara_spawn_flags_set(chara, idx, flags)` | Sets the flags of a placed spawn. |
| `sh.chara_state(chara, name[, fallback]) -> state` | The number of a scene state of a character by name. |
| `sh.cutscene_border(state)` | The cutscene's black bars; 20 shows them. |
| `sh.cutscene_flag(on)` | Sets or clears the cutscene flag. |
| `sh.cutscene_timer_get() -> t` | The cutscene clock. |
| `sh.cutscene_timer_set(t)` | Sets the cutscene clock. |
| `sh.delta_time_get() -> dt` | The frame's time step, Q12 seconds. |
| `sh.delta_time_reset()` | Puts the frame's time step back. |
| `sh.delta_time_set(dt)` | Sets the frame's time step (halve it to slow a scene down). |
| `sh.dms_camera_apply(t, buf)` | Moves the camera as the cutscene has it at time t. |
| `sh.dms_chara_apply(slot, track, t, buf)` | Puts a character in the pose of a cutscene track ("HERO") at time t. |
| `sh.dms_fix(buf)` | Prepares the cutscene data of a buffer. |
| `sh.dms_ready()` | Starts the cutscene that was read into the buffer. |
| `sh.event_activation_type_get() -> type` | How the active event was started (item use or inspection); -1 outside an event. |
| `sh.event_bg_texture_cmd(cmd, file, inc_sub_step)` | Background picture step: 0 queue read, 1 await load, 2 draw, 3 store, 4 queue the second, 5 draw the second, 6 restore, 7 all in turn. |
| `sh.event_bg_texture_fade_in(file, t0, t1)` | Loads a background picture and fades it in. |
| `sh.event_bg_texture_fade_out(...)` | Fades the background picture out. |
| `sh.event_chara_anim(cmd, slot, anim_state, inc_sub_step)` | Animation command for a character: 0 set state, 1 await the clip's end, 2 lock, 3 unlock, 4 reset. |
| `sh.event_common_item_take(item, flag)` | The pickup of a common item (FirstAidKit, HealthDrink, Ampoule, HandgunBullets, RifleShells, ShotgunShells) with its standard question. |
| `sh.event_fade_cmd(cmd, fade_out, fade_type, timestep, inc_sub_step)` | A screen fade as an event step. |
| `sh.event_inv_item_cmd(cmd, item[, count], inc_sub_step)` | A pickup with the inspection view: cmd 0 queue load, 1 await load, 2 nothing, 3 add the item, 6 everything in turn. |
| `sh.event_item_take(item, count, flag, msg)` | The item pickup step: asks with msg, gives count of item and sets flag. |
| `sh.event_msg(has_selection, msg[, step0, step1, step2, inc_sub_step])` | Shows a message in an event step, with an optional choice that branches to the given steps. |
| `sh.event_msg_audio(msg, idx, cmds)` | Shows voiced lines: idx is a map variable name or a number, cmds the name of a list of voice commands. |
| `sh.event_msg_dimmed_bg(file, f0, f1, m0, m1)` | Shows messages over a dimmed full-screen picture. |
| `sh.event_msg_with_audio(msg, voice_cmd)` | Shows a voiced line. |
| `sh.event_msg_with_bg(file, fade0, fade1, msg)` | Shows a message over a full-screen picture, fading it in and out. |
| `sh.event_msg_with_sfx(msg, sound)` | Shows a message and plays a sound at the event's point. |
| `sh.event_msg_with_texture(tex, f0, f1, msg0, msg1)` | Shows messages over a texture picture, fading it in and out. |
| `sh.event_paper_map_take(page, flag, msg)` | The pickup of a paper map page. |
| `sh.event_point() -> x, y, z` | The point of interest of the active event. |
| `sh.event_selection(has_sel, msg[, s0, s1, s2, secondary])` | Shows a choice and branches the event step on the answer. |
| `sh.event_step_get(i) -> value` | Step i (0..2) of the event's step machine. |
| `sh.event_step_increment(i)` | Advances step i of the event's step machine. |
| `sh.event_step_increment_after_fade(step, cond, fade_type, timestep, reset)` | Advances the event step when a screen fade has finished. |
| `sh.event_step_increment_delayed(delay, reset)` | Advances the event step after a delay. |
| `sh.event_step_reset()` | Resets the steps of the event's step machine. |
| `sh.event_step_set(i, v)` | Sets step i of the event's step machine (raw; sh.event.step_set also resets the lower steps and timers). |
| `sh.event_sys_state_branch_on_flag(flag, step_true, step_false, set_sub_step)` | Branches the event step on an event flag (step_true -1 is the default branch). |
| `sh.event_tween_linear(target, duration, timer) -> value` | A linear tween towards target over duration, Q12. |
| `sh.event_tween_reset(timer)` | Restarts a tween's timer. |
| `sh.event_wait_player_stop()` | Waits until Harry has stopped moving. |
| `sh.event_wait_timer(duration, inc_sub_step)` | Waits for a time inside an event step. |
| `sh.event_waypoint_player(anim, count, inc_sub_step)` | Walks Harry along the event's path points. |
| `sh.event_waypoint_set(abs, slot, idx, angle, x, z)` | Sets a point of the path a character walks in an event. |
| `sh.fade(fade_in[, white])` | Starts a screen fade: in (true) or out, to white when white is true. |
| `sh.fade_done() -> bool` | True when the screen fade has finished. |
| `sh.file_number(path) -> number` | The number of a game file by its path. |
| `sh.flag_get(flag) -> bool` | Reads an event flag by name (gamedata/flags) or number. |
| `sh.flag_set(flag, value)` | Sets or clears an event flag. |
| `sh.flag_set_alt(flag)` | Sets the flag the way an event writes its finishing flag. |
| `sh.flashlight(on)` | Turns the flashlight on or off. |
| `sh.flashlight_attrs_fix()` | Restores the flashlight's light after a scene changed it. |
| `sh.fs_entry_loaded(q) -> bool` | True when a queued read has finished. |
| `sh.fs_queue_done() -> bool` | True when the file queue is empty. |
| `sh.fs_read(file, buf) -> queue_entry` | Queues the read of a game file into a buffer. |
| `sh.fs_read_dms(file)` | Queues the read of a cutscene file. |
| `sh.fs_seek(file)` | Queues a seek to a game file. |
| `sh.fs_wait()` | Waits for the file queue. |
| `sh.game_timer_update()` | Advances the played time. |
| `sh.give_item(item[, n])` | Adds n (default 1) of an item to the inventory; item is its name or number. |
| `sh.has_item(item) -> bool` | True when the player carries the item. |
| `sh.held_item_hide()` | Hides the item in Harry's hand. |
| `sh.held_item_prev()` | Puts back the item Harry held before held_item_set. |
| `sh.held_item_set(item)` | Puts an item model in Harry's hand. |
| `sh.held_item_show()` | Shows the item in Harry's hand. |
| `sh.input_action(action[, mode]) -> bool` | A control of the layout (enter, cancel, skip, action, aim, light, run, view, stepLeft, stepRight, pause, item, map, option): mode 0 held, 1 pressed this tick, 2 released, 3 pressed or repeating. |
| `sh.input_axis(stick, axis) -> value` | A stick axis, -128..127. |
| `sh.item_count(item) -> count` | How many of the item the player carries. |
| `sh.item_remove(item, n) -> bool` | Removes n of an item, frees its slot and sorts the inventory. |
| `sh.light_bones_clear()` | Detaches the light from the bones it follows. |
| `sh.light_intensity_get() -> intensity` | The intensity of the flashlight's light. |
| `sh.light_intensity_set(intensity)` | Sets the intensity of the flashlight's light. |
| `sh.log([level,] msg)` | Writes a line to the game log; level 1 makes it a warning. print(...) does the same. |
| `sh.map_event_set(sys_state, param, map, complete_flag)` | Queues a synthetic map event; the game picks it up on the next tick. |
| `sh.map_name() -> name` | The name of the loaded map, like "map1_s02". |
| `sh.math_atan2(x, z) -> angle` | The Q12 angle of a direction, as the game computes it. |
| `sh.math_cos(angle) -> q12` | Cosine of a Q12 angle from the game's table, Q12. |
| `sh.math_sin(angle) -> q12` | Sine of a Q12 angle from the game's table, Q12. |
| `sh.math_vec2_mag_q6(x, z) -> length` | The length of a 2D vector, computed in Q6 so large values do not overflow. |
| `sh.msg_draw(msg) -> state` | Draws a map message for this tick: 0 still showing, -1 finished, 1..3 the chosen answer. Call once a tick; msg is a text key or number. |
| `sh.msg_index(key) -> index` | The number of a message key in the current map's messages; -1 when the map has none. |
| `sh.overlay_screen_hide(fade0, fade1)` | Hides the full-screen texture, fading it out. |
| `sh.overlay_screen_show(file, fade0, fade1)` | Shows a full-screen texture (a clock face, a boiler panel), fading it in. |
| `sh.pad_effect(idx, level)` | Runs a vibration effect this tick (config/pad_vibration.json). |
| `sh.paper_map_cmd(cmd, page)` | A command of the paper map screen for a page (a name of gamedata/paper_maps.json). |
| `sh.paper_map_grant(page)` | Counts a paper map page as found. |
| `sh.paper_map_state(state, page)` | Sets the state of the paper map screen for a page (a name of gamedata/paper_maps.json). |
| `sh.pickup_animate(item) -> bool` | Turns the picked item's model; true once it faces the camera. |
| `sh.player_fall_tick(dir)` | One tick of a scripted fall (+1) or rise (-1) of Harry. |
| `sh.player_freeze(on)` | Takes the control of Harry away from the player (true) or gives it back. |
| `sh.player_move_speed_clear()` | Zeroes Harry's movement speed. |
| `sh.player_pos() -> x, y, z` | Harry's position in Q12 (4096 = 1 m, y grows downwards). |
| `sh.player_rot_y_get() -> angle` | Harry's rotation about the vertical axis, Q12. |
| `sh.player_rotate(angle)` | Turns Harry by a Q12 angle. |
| `sh.player_set_pos(x, y, z)` | Moves Harry to a position in Q12. |
| `sh.player_vel_y_get() -> speed` | Harry's vertical speed. |
| `sh.player_vel_y_set(speed)` | Sets Harry's vertical speed. |
| `sh.player_weapon_attack_get() -> attack` | The attack of the weapon in Harry's hands. |
| `sh.player_weapon_attack_set(attack)` | Sets the attack of the weapon in Harry's hands. |
| `sh.player_weapon_restore()` | Equips again the weapon player_weapon_stash put away. |
| `sh.player_weapon_stash()` | Puts the equipped weapon away for a scene; player_weapon_restore brings it back. |
| `sh.rng_int(low, high) -> n` | A random integer in low..high from the game's generator (signed remainder). |
| `sh.rng_uint(low, high) -> n` | A random integer in low..high from the game's generator (unsigned remainder). |
| `sh.savegame_get(field) -> value` | A field of the save: "map_idx", "paper_map_idx" (a page name), "item_toggle_flags". |
| `sh.savegame_set(field, v)` | Writes a field of the save (see savegame_get). |
| `sh.screen_fade_finished() -> bool` | True when the screen fade has finished. |
| `sh.screen_fade_reset_timestep()` | Puts the screen fade's speed back to its default. |
| `sh.screen_fade_timestep_get() -> q12` | The screen fade's time step. |
| `sh.screen_fade_timestep_set(q12)` | Sets the screen fade's time step. |
| `sh.sd_call(n)` | Sends a command number to the sound driver. |
| `sh.sd_play_sfx(sound, balance, vol)` | Plays a sound with a stereo balance and a volume. |
| `sh.selection_silent(on)` | Makes the next "yes" of a choice silent. |
| `sh.sfx(sound)` | Plays a sound by registry name or number. |
| `sh.sfx_3d(sound[, vol_q8])` | Plays a sound at the point of the active map event. |
| `sh.sfx_3d_at(sound, x, y, z[, vol_q8])` | Plays a sound at a position in the world. |
| `sh.sfx_falloff_pitch_play(sound, x, y, z[, vol[, falloff[, pitch]]])` | Plays a sound at a position with a distance falloff and a pitch. |
| `sh.sfx_flags_pitch_play(sound, x, y, z, vol, flags, pitch)` | sfx_flags_play with a pitch. |
| `sh.sfx_flags_play(sound, x, y, z[, vol[, flags]])` | Plays a sound at a position with flags: 1 mono, 2 no distance attenuation, 4 update attributes. |
| `sh.sfx_pitch_play(sound, x, y, z[, vol[, pitch]])` | Plays a sound at a position with a pitch. |
| `sh.sfx_stop(sound)` | Stops a sound. |
| `sh.spawn(fn)` | Starts fn as a coroutine the host steps every tick (up to 256 alive); inside it use wait(), wait_frames() and wait_until(). |
| `sh.state_set(sys_state)` | The next system state; 0 returns to gameplay and ends the handler. |
| `sh.state_timer_get() -> t` | The state's timer (the cross-fade alpha, Q12 0..1). |
| `sh.state_timer_set(v)` | Sets the state's timer. |
| `sh.sys_flags_get() -> flags` | The system flags. |
| `sh.sys_flags_set(flags)` | Sets the system flags. |
| `sh.sys_timer_get() -> t` | The system state's timer. |
| `sh.sys_timer_set(t)` | Sets the system state's timer. |
| `sh.take_item(item[, n])` | Removes n (default 1) of an item from the inventory. |
| `sh.text(key) -> text, found` | The text of a key in the current language, and whether the key exists. |
| `sh.vc_cam_target(x, y, z, warp)` | Sets the position the camera moves to (Q12). |
| `sh.vc_stereo_balance(x, y, z) -> balance` | The stereo balance of a world point as the camera hears it. |
| `sh.vc_view_position() -> x, y, z` | The camera's position. |
| `sh.vc_watch_target(x, y, z, warp)` | Sets the point the camera watches (Q12). |
| `sh.water_effect_disable()` | Turns the water effect off. |
| `sh.water_effect_enable()` | Turns the water effect on. |
| `sh.world_object_add(name)` | Adds a world object of the map by name to this frame's objects. |
| `sh.xa_preload(idx)` | Prepares a streamed voice line for playing. |

## sh.audio

Sound effects and the music track (the named twins of `sh.sfx`, `sh.sfx_stop`, `sh.bgm`).

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.audio.bgm(track)` | Changes the music track. |
| `sh.audio.sfx(sound)` | Plays a sound by registry name or number. |
| `sh.audio.sfx_stop(sound)` | Stops a sound. |

## sh.camera

The event camera and the camera's own state.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.camera.angle_speed_to_target(speed, angle, target, accel, max_speed, decel)` | The camera's new turning speed towards a target angle. |
| `sh.camera.auto_return(...)` | Gives the camera back to the game's automatic control. |
| `sh.camera.exec()` | Runs one step of the camera now. |
| `sh.camera.is_chase() -> bool` | True while the camera follows Harry on its own. |
| `sh.camera.look(x, y, z, a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, warp)` | The point the event camera looks at: x, y, z in metres, the rest as camera_pos. |
| `sh.camera.look_at(...)` | Sets the point the event camera looks at; a reference is a map variable name or a scratch vector. |
| `sh.camera.look_at_height() -> q12` | The height of the point the camera looks at. |
| `sh.camera.pos(x, y, z, a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, warp)` | The event camera's position: x, y, z in metres, a0..a6 the offsets, accelerations and speeds in Q12, warp jumps there at once. |
| `sh.camera.position(...)` | Sets where the event camera moves to. |
| `sh.camera.self_view_enabled()` | True when the "view mode" option is Self View. |
| `sh.camera.set_user_max_speed_xz(value)` | Sets: the largest horizontal speed of the script's camera. |
| `sh.camera.set_user_max_speed_y(value)` | Sets: the largest vertical speed of the script's camera. |
| `sh.camera.user_max_speed_xz() -> value` | The largest horizontal speed of the script's camera. |
| `sh.camera.user_max_speed_y() -> value` | The largest vertical speed of the script's camera. |
| `sh.camera.view_button_active()` | The look-view request of this frame ("view control: reverse" flips the held button). |
| `sh.camera.view_button_was_active()` | The look-view request of the frame before. |

## sh.chara

Character types of the loaded map: spawning, their loads and behaviours.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.chara.anim_data_alloc(anim_slot, type, buffer, bones)` | Loads the type's animations into an animation slot from a file buffer. |
| `sh.chara.anim_file_set(type, file)` | Sets the animation file the type loads from now on. |
| `sh.chara.model_load(type, model_slot, buffer, page, u, v, palette_x, palette_y)` | Loads the type's model from a file buffer, its texture at the place given. |
| `sh.chara.model_loads_process()` | Finishes the queued model loads. |
| `sh.chara.spawn(chara, spawn_flags, x, z[, rot[, step]]) -> slot` | Spawns a character at x, z; -1 when it cannot be placed. |
| `sh.chara.spawn_entry_set(entry, on)` | Marks an entry of the map's spawn table as in play, so the map's spawner leaves it alone. |
| `sh.chara.spawn_flags_set(chara, idx, flags)` | Sets the flags of a placed spawn. |
| `sh.chara.update_as("Incubator", "Unknown23")` | The type runs its own behaviour or another type's (a boss playing another fight). |
| `sh.chara.update_variant_set(type, variant)` | The type's map update becomes its behavior.lua, variant 0 or 1. |

## sh.config

A mod's own settings ([scripting.md](scripting.md#mod-settings-shconfig)).

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.config.declare{key, type, default, min, max, step, choices, restart}` | Declares a setting of the mod ("<mod id>.<key>"): type number, bool, choice or string. The saved value wins over default. |
| `sh.config.default(key) -> value` | The default of a declared setting. |
| `sh.config.get(key) -> value` | The value of a declared setting; nil when it is not declared. |
| `sh.config.needs_restart() -> bool` | True when a changed setting takes effect only after a restart. |
| `sh.config.on_change(key, fn)` | Calls fn when the setting changes (menu scripts only). |
| `sh.config.reset(key)` | Puts a setting back to its default. |
| `sh.config.set(key, value) -> bool` | Sets a setting after checking its type and range, saves it and calls the on_change handlers. |

## sh.console

Console commands of a mod ([scripting.md](scripting.md#console-commands-shconsole)).

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.console.exec(line)` | Runs a console command line. |
| `sh.console.print(text)` | Prints a line in the console. |
| `sh.console.register{name, aliases, group, help, details, args, run}` | Adds a console command: args are {name, type, optional, values, complete}; run(args) returns the text to print. |
| `sh.console.unregister(name) -> bool` | Removes a console command this script registered. |

## sh.cutscene

Cutscenes: the letterbox, the tracks of a cutscene file, the cutscene clock.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.cutscene.border_reset(...)` | Removes the cutscene's black bars. |
| `sh.cutscene.border_show(...)` | Shows the cutscene's black bars. |
| `sh.cutscene.camera(t, buf, pos_ref, look_ref)` | Moves the camera as the cutscene has it at time t. |
| `sh.cutscene.camera_target(pos_ref, look_ref, angle_ref, t, buf) -> projection` | Writes the cutscene camera's position and look-at point at time t into references. |
| `sh.cutscene.chara(slot, name, t, buf)` | Puts a character in the pose of a cutscene track at time t. |
| `sh.cutscene.frames(buf) -> frames` | The length of the cutscene in a buffer; -1 when there is none. |
| `sh.cutscene.light(t, buf[, light, target])` | The light follows the cutscene's light tracks at time t ("LIGHT" and "L_INT" unless named). |
| `sh.cutscene.load(path, buf) -> 1 or 0` | Loads convert/cutscenes/<path>.dms.json into a buffer slot to play at once (a mod's own cutscene). |
| `sh.cutscene.prepare(buf)` | Makes the cutscene read into a file buffer ready. |
| `sh.cutscene.timer_advance(timer_ref, rate, start, end, hold_at_end, advance_step)` | Runs a cutscene clock inside a window; past its end the event steps on when advance_step is set. |
| `sh.cutscene.transform(name, t, buf) -> x, y, z, rx, ry, rz` | The pose of a cutscene track at time t. |
| `sh.cutscene.transform_to(pos_ref, rot_ref, name, t, buf)` | Writes a track's position and rotation at time t into two references. |

Not described yet: `sh.cutscene.border_state(...)`, `sh.cutscene.set_border_state(...)`.

## sh.effects

Effect pools and glow fields of the maps.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_add_bones(name, pos_ref, bones_ref, timer_ref)` | Adds an emitter that follows bones to a glow field. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_add_flash(name, timer_ref)` | Adds a flash driven by a timer to a glow field. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_add_point(name, pos_ref, rot_ref)` | Adds a point emitter to a glow field of effects/glow_fields.json. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_add_ray(name, from_ref, to_ref)` | Adds a ray emitter between two points to a glow field. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_clear_emitters(name)` | Removes a glow field's emitters. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_decay(name)` | Lets a glow field decay by one step. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_draw(name)` | Draws a glow field. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_draw_mesh(name, mesh)` | Draws a glow field over a mesh. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_emit(name)` | Runs a glow field's emitters. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_remove(name, kind)` | Removes the emitters of one kind from a glow field. |
| `sh.effects.glow_field_reset(name)` | Resets a glow field. |
| `sh.effects.slot_free(type, count)` | Frees the slots of an effect type among the first count slots. |
| `sh.effects.slot_y_add(type, dy, count)` | Moves the slots of an effect type among the first count slots up by dy. |
| `sh.effects.smoke_column_start()` | Starts the map's smoke column. |

The engine version ([versioning.md](versioning.md)).

## sh.entity

Characters as the behaviour scripts of `gamedata/chara/` see them: spawning, bones, clips, rays, and the helpers of the base game's own characters.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.entity.aabb_visible(x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1) -> 1 or 0` | Whether a box is inside the camera's view. |
| `sh.entity.anim(slot) -> clip, phase, keyframe, time` | The state of the character's clip. |
| `sh.entity.anim_play(slot[, frozen])` | Steps the clip; frozen steps it without time passing. |
| `sh.entity.anim_set(slot, status[, time])` | Sets the clip table status directly. |
| `sh.entity.anim_status_set(slot, status, kf)` | Switches the character to a clip status at a keyframe. |
| `sh.entity.anim_step(slot)` | One tick of the character's clip table entry. |
| `sh.entity.attack(slot, arm, weapon_attack, x, y, z, target, angle_y, angle_x) -> result` | An attack the engine resolves; -1 when it misses. |
| `sh.entity.attack_number(name) -> number` | The row of config/attacks.json by its name ("StalkerLunge"); take it once when the script loads. |
| `sh.entity.bone(slot, i) -> x, y, z` | The world position of a bone in geometry units (256 = 1 m). |
| `sh.entity.bone_count(slot) -> count` | The number of bones of the character's skeleton. |
| `sh.entity.chara(slot) -> id` | The character type in the slot. |
| `sh.entity.clip(slot, name) -> index` | The index of a clip by name; -1 when the character has none. |
| `sh.entity.clip_duration(slot, status) -> q12` | The duration of a clip table entry. |
| `sh.entity.clip_duration_set(slot, status, q12)` | Sets the duration of a clip table entry. |
| `sh.entity.clip_end(slot, status) -> keyframe` | The last keyframe of a clip table entry. |
| `sh.entity.clip_info(slot, status) -> first, last, variable_speed, speed, link` | A clip table entry. |
| `sh.entity.clip_start(slot, status) -> keyframe` | The first keyframe of a clip table entry. |
| `sh.entity.collide(slot, dx, dy, dz)` | Moves the character by a step against walls and other characters. |
| `sh.entity.collision_state(slot) -> state` | The character's 4-bit collision state. |
| `sh.entity.create(chara, x, z, rot_y[, state[, ai]]) -> slot` | Creates a character on the ground at x, z; -1 when it cannot be placed. ai is "auto", "full", "fallback" or "none". |
| `sh.entity.darkness_at(x, y, z) -> 0..255` | How dark a point of the world is. |
| `sh.entity.effect_spawn(slot, x, y, z, kind, variant)` | Spawns a character effect at a point. |
| `sh.entity.enemy_defeated(slot)` | Marks the enemy as defeated: it does not come back. |
| `sh.entity.engine_spawn(slot) -> 1 or 0` | 1 when the engine created the character (console, menu, create), not the map's room spawner. |
| `sh.entity.exists(slot) -> 1 or 0` | 1 when the slot holds a character. |
| `sh.entity.footstep_sfx(ground_type[, chara_id]) -> sound, walk_pitch, run_pitch` | The footstep sound for a ground type from the data. |
| `sh.entity.get(slot, field) -> value` | A field of the character's record by name (control_state, state_step, anim_status, pos_x, rot_y, move_speed, health, flags, ...). |
| `sh.entity.ground_at(x, z) -> y` | The ground under a point. |
| `sh.entity.ground_height(x, z) -> y` | The height of the ground under a point. |
| `sh.entity.ground_kind(x, z) -> kind` | The kind of the collision cell under a point. |
| `sh.entity.harry(name) -> value` | A value of Harry's state outside his record (lower_body, upper_body, state, aiming, weapon_attack, ammo, ...). |
| `sh.entity.harry_bone_world(bone) -> x, y, z` | The world position of one of Harry's bones. |
| `sh.entity.harry_game_over()` | Ends the game: Harry is dead. |
| `sh.entity.has_ai(slot) -> running, kind` | 1 when the slot runs a behaviour this tick; kind: 1 the map's AI, 2 its own, 3 the fallback, 4 none, 0 a character of the map. |
| `sh.entity.heading_toward(slot, dist, x, z, span, nearest) -> angle` | A heading towards a point that avoids obstacles. |
| `sh.entity.health(slot) -> q12` | The character's health. |
| `sh.entity.in_active_cell(x, z) -> 1 or 0` | Whether the point is in a loaded cell of the map. |
| `sh.entity.item_number(name) -> number` | The number of an item by name. |
| `sh.entity.keyframe_passed(slot, from_time, kf) -> 1 or 0` | 1 when keyframe kf lies between from_time and the clip's current time. |
| `sh.entity.map_var(name) -> value` | A map variable by name. |
| `sh.entity.max_health() -> q12` | Harry's maximum health (gameplay.json). |
| `sh.entity.move(slot, push_x, push_z)` | Moves the character along heading_angle by move_speed, with falling and walls. |
| `sh.entity.npc_slot_count() -> count` | The number of character slots. |
| `sh.entity.param(slot, name[, fallback_q12]) -> value` | A parameter of the character's data ("params") as Q12. |
| `sh.entity.play(slot, clip[, blend]) -> 1 or 0` | Plays a clip by its name in character.json ("walk_forward") or its index; blend 0 starts it without the transition. |
| `sh.entity.player_blocked(slot) -> 1 or 0` | Whether something stands between the character and Harry. |
| `sh.entity.player_control_disabled() -> 1 or 0` | 1 while the player has no control of Harry. |
| `sh.entity.player_noise(slot, dist, scale) -> 1 or 0` | Whether the character hears Harry. |
| `sh.entity.player_state() -> state` | Harry's state. |
| `sh.entity.player_visible(slot, n, dist, step) -> 1 or 0` | Whether the character sees Harry. |
| `sh.entity.position(slot) -> x, y, z` | The character's position, Q12. |
| `sh.entity.ray_trace(x, y, z, tx, ty, tz)` | Traces a ray through the world's collision. |
| `sh.entity.ray_trace_slot(slot, x, y, z, dx, dy, dz) -> hit, slot, x, y, z` | Traces a ray from a character: what it hit and where. |
| `sh.entity.ray_world(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1)` | Traces a segment against the world's geometry. |
| `sh.entity.remove(slot) -> 1 or 0` | Removes the character of a slot. |
| `sh.entity.rotation(slot) -> rx, ry, rz` | The character's rotation, Q12 angles. |
| `sh.entity.set(slot, field, v)` | Writes a field of the character's record by name. |
| `sh.entity.set_collision_state(slot, v)` | Sets the character's collision state. |
| `sh.entity.set_harry(name, v)` | Writes a value of Harry's state (a read-only one is an error). |
| `sh.entity.set_health(slot, q12)` | Sets the character's health. |
| `sh.entity.set_map_var(name, v)` | Writes a map variable by name. |
| `sh.entity.set_position(slot, x, y, z)` | Moves the character, Q12. |
| `sh.entity.set_rotation(slot, rx, ry, rz)` | Turns the character, Q12 angles. |
| `sh.entity.set_sys(name, v[, i])` | Writes an engine value by name (see sys). |
| `sh.entity.sfx_3d(slot, sfx, vol, kind)` | Plays a positioned sound of the character. |
| `sh.entity.sfx_at(slot, sfx, vol_q8, pitch)` | Plays a sound at the character's position. |
| `sh.entity.sfx_falloff(slot, sfx, vol, falloff, pitch)` | Plays a sound at the character's position with a distance falloff. |
| `sh.entity.sfx_flags(slot, sfx, vol_q8, flags)` | Plays a sound at the character's position with flags. |
| `sh.entity.sfx_flags_at(sfx, x, y, z, vol, flags)` | Plays a sound at a position with flags. |
| `sh.entity.sfx_stop(sfx)` | Stops a sound. |
| `sh.entity.sound(slot, name[, fallback]) -> sound` | The sound of the character's "sounds" slot by name. |
| `sh.entity.spawn{chara, x, z, rot, ai, state} -> slot or nil, err` | Places a character (a folder name of chara/) at x, z: ai "auto", "full", "fallback" or "none"; state is the first step of its behaviour. |
| `sh.entity.spawn_kind(slot) -> kind` | The character's spawn kind: 0 enemy, 1 boss, 2 actor, 3 prop. |
| `sh.entity.sys(name[, i]) -> value` | An engine value by name: chara_group_flags, target_npc, map_effects, sys_state. |
| `sh.entity.wall_detect(slot, dx, dy, dz)` | Tests a step of the character against the walls. |
| `sh.entity.weapon_attack_info(attack) -> reach, hit_start, hit_length, clip` | The reach, hit window and magazine of an attack. |
| `sh.entity.weapon_damage(attack) -> damage` | The damage of an attack of config/attacks.json. |
| `sh.entity.weapon_number(name) -> number` | The number of a weapon by name. |

## sh.event

The step machine of a map event and its per-tick steppers.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.event.bg_texture(cmd, file, inc_sub_step)` | A command of the background picture: 0 queue the read, 1 await it, 2 draw, 3 store, 4 queue the second, 5 draw the second, 6 restore, 7 all in turn. |
| `sh.event.branch_on_flag(flag, step_true, step_false, set_sub_step)` | Sets the event step by a flag; step_true -1 keeps the default branch. |
| `sh.event.fade(...)` | A screen fade as an event step. |
| `sh.event.flag(...)` | Reads an event flag by name. |
| `sh.event.flag_clear(...)` | Clears an event flag by name. |
| `sh.event.flag_set(...)` | Sets an event flag by name. |
| `sh.event.inv_item(cmd, item, count, inc_sub_step)` | A pickup with the inspection view: 0 queue the load, 1 await it, 3 add the item. |
| `sh.event.item_used()` | True when the event was started by using an item. |
| `sh.event.path_point_set(abs, slot, idx, angle, x, z)` | Sets a point of the event's path. |
| `sh.event.path_walk_player(anim, count, inc_sub_step)` | Walks Harry along the event's path points. |
| `sh.event.point_position()` | The active event's point of interest, Q12. |
| `sh.event.set_state_timer(value)` | Sets: the timer of the system state (the first step word of the event). |
| `sh.event.set_step_timer(value)` | Sets: the timer of the event's step (the second step word of the event). |
| `sh.event.set_sys_state(value)` | Sets: the system state the game is in. |
| `sh.event.state_set_next(sys_state)` | Sets the next system state. |
| `sh.event.state_timer() -> value` | The timer of the system state (the first step word of the event). |
| `sh.event.step_increment(...)` | Advances a step of the event's step machine. |
| `sh.event.step_increment_after_fade(cmd, fade_out, fade_type, timestep, inc_sub_step)` | A screen fade command of the event; the same function as sh.event.fade. |
| `sh.event.step_increment_delayed(duration, inc_sub_step)` | Waits on the event's timer; the same function as sh.event.wait_timer. |
| `sh.event.step_reset(...)` | Resets the steps of the event's step machine. |
| `sh.event.step_set(i, v)` | Sets step i of the event's step machine and resets the lower steps and the timers. |
| `sh.event.step_timer() -> value` | The timer of the event's step (the second step word of the event). |
| `sh.event.sys_state() -> value` | The system state the game is in. |
| `sh.event.tween_linear(target, duration, timer) -> q12` | A linear tween driven by a timer. |
| `sh.event.tween_reset(timer)` | Resets the timer of a tween. |
| `sh.event.used_item_is(item)` | True when the item that started the event is this one. |
| `sh.event.wait_player_stop()` | Holds the event step until Harry stands still. |
| `sh.event.wait_timer(...)` | Waits for a time inside an event step. |

Not described yet: `sh.event.bg_texture_fade_out(...)`, `sh.event.bg_texture_load_fade_in(...)`, `sh.event.ramp_advance(...)`, `sh.event.ramp_reset(...)`.

## sh.hooks

The event bus ([events.md](events.md)).

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.hooks.emit(event[, fields[, cancellable]]) -> fields, cancelled` | Sends an event to its handlers; a mod names its own events "<mod id>:<name>". |
| `sh.hooks.has(event) -> bool` | True when the event has handlers. |
| `sh.hooks.list([event]) -> rows` | The handlers in call order: {event, owner, id, priority, handle}. |
| `sh.hooks.off(handle) or sh.hooks.off(event, id) -> bool` | Removes one of this script's handlers. |
| `sh.hooks.on(event, fn[, {priority = 0, id = "name"}]) -> handle` | Calls fn(ev) on an engine event; subscribing again with the same event and id replaces the function. Higher priority runs first. |

## sh.input

Controls as the game reads them.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.input.action(action[, mode]) -> bool` | A control of the layout (enter, cancel, skip, action, aim, light, run, view, stepLeft, stepRight, pause, item, map, option): mode 0 held, 1 pressed this tick, 2 released, 3 pressed or repeating. |
| `sh.input.axis(stick, axis) -> value` | A stick axis, -128..127. |
| `sh.input.control(name) -> value` | A control of this tick as Harry's controller reads it: forward, back, turn_left, turn_right, run, aim, attack, action_pressed, ... |
| `sh.input.controls_clear()` | Clears the controls of this tick. |
| `sh.input.move_stick() -> x, y, up, down` | The movement stick, -128..127 (forward is negative y). |
| `sh.input.pad_button(button, mode[, pad]) -> bits` | The pad bits of a button; pad 1 is the second pad. |
| `sh.input.pad_direction(dir, mode) -> bits` | The pad bits of a direction; test with ~= 0. |
| `sh.input.pad_mask(action, mode) -> bits` | The pad bits of a layout action; test with ~= 0. |
| `sh.input.player_flag(name) -> value` | One of the controller's 16 output flags (the last tick's value). |
| `sh.input.set_control(name, v)` | Overrides a control of this tick. |
| `sh.input.set_player_flag(name, v)` | Sets one of the controller's output flags for this tick. |
| `sh.input.stick_zone() -> outside, turn_left, turn_right, forward, back` | Where the movement stick is. |
| `sh.input.touch_prompt(control[, icon])` | Asks a touch screen for an on-screen control this tick ("struggle", or "attack" shown with the weapon down), with the picture of gamedata/ui/touch/<icon>.svg; renewed every tick the moment lasts. Only the touch controls read it. |

## sh.math

The game's integer math, bit-exact.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.math.atan2(x, z) -> angle` | The Q12 angle of a direction, as the game computes it. |
| `sh.math.bone_point(bone_ref, x, y, z) -> x, y, z` | A point of a bone's space in the world, in geometry units (256 = 1 m). |
| `sh.math.cos(angle) -> q12` | Cosine of a Q12 angle from the game's table, Q12. |
| `sh.math.distance_2d(x1, z1, x2, z2) -> distance` | The distance between two points on the ground plane. |
| `sh.math.segment_distance(px, pz, ax, az, bx, bz) -> distance, t` | The distance from a point to a segment and where along the segment the nearest point is. |
| `sh.math.sin(angle) -> q12` | Sine of a Q12 angle from the game's table, Q12. |
| `sh.math.sqrt(v) -> root` | The game's integer square root. |
| `sh.math.vec2_len_q6(x, z) -> length` | The length of a 2D vector, computed in Q6 so large values do not overflow. |
| `sh.math.vector_length(x, y, z) -> length` | The length of a 3D vector. |

## sh.menu

Menus ([scripting.md](scripting.md#menus-and-option-pages)); only in menu scripts.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.menu.action(name, fn)` | Menu scripts: registers a native action that rows refer to with native = name. |
| `sh.menu.add_page{ parent, id, title, rows[, label, help, link_id, on_open, leave_confirm, on_leave] } -> bool` | Menu scripts: describes a page and puts a link to it into the menu parent; with parent "options" the link goes onto the Mod Options page. |
| `sh.menu.after_load(fn)` | Menu scripts: fn runs once when all menu files, the base and the mods, have run. |
| `sh.menu.append_rows(id, rows) -> bool` | Menu scripts: adds rows to an existing menu, before its tail rows; false when there is no such menu. |
| `sh.menu.close() -> bool` | Menu scripts: closes the open menu. |
| `sh.menu.define{ id, title, rows[, on_open, on_update, leave_confirm, on_leave] }` | Menu scripts: describes a menu; a second define with the same id replaces it. on_update runs every frame while the menu is the current one. |
| `sh.menu.focus(menu_id, row_id)` | Menu scripts: brings the row row_id of the menu menu_id to the top of the window once that menu is the current one, and selects the first row from there that can be selected (a page that defined itself again shows its new start). |
| `sh.menu.is_open() -> bool` | Menu scripts: whether a menu is open. |
| `sh.menu.list(name, fn)` | Menu scripts: registers a native list of choices that rows refer to with native = name. |
| `sh.menu.native_visible(name) -> bool` | Menu scripts: the answer of the engine's visibility predicate `name` (the one rows name in `native`); false when there is none. |
| `sh.menu.open(id) -> bool` | Menu scripts: opens a menu as a screen of the player. |
| `sh.menu.page_count(parent) -> n` | Menu scripts: how many pages were added to a menu with add_page. |
| `sh.menu.run(name) -> bool` | Menu scripts: runs the engine's menu action `name`; false when there is none. |
| `sh.menu.value(name, get[, set])` | Menu scripts: registers a native value that rows refer to with native = name. |

## sh.mods

Other mods ([scripting.md](scripting.md#talking-to-other-mods)).

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.mods.apply_live() -> bool` | Menu scripts: after save(), applies a choice that differs only by mods with "requires_restart": false. |
| `sh.mods.dir() -> path` | Menu scripts: the mods folder beside the executable; "" when there is none. |
| `sh.mods.editable() -> bool` | Menu scripts: whether mods can be changed now (only in the Options of the title screen). |
| `sh.mods.get(id) -> {id, name, version, api}` | An active mod and the table it published with mod.export; nil when the mod is not active. |
| `sh.mods.import_can(kind) -> bool` | Menu scripts: whether the system has a dialog to pick a mod "folder" or "zip". |
| `sh.mods.import_clear()` | Menu scripts: forgets the scanned pick and the last import's report. |
| `sh.mods.import_found() -> {source, zip, error, detail, mods}` | Menu scripts: the mods found in the pick, each with id, name, version, status (new, update, same, older, invalid), reason, notes ({kind, detail, need, have}: the parts of ui.mods.import.note.<kind>) and selected. |
| `sh.mods.import_last() -> report, error` | Menu scripts: the last import's {added, replaced} ids or nil, and its error ("" none). |
| `sh.mods.import_pick(kind) -> bool` | Menu scripts: opens the system's dialog for a mod "folder" or "zip"; the answer arrives later through import_poll. |
| `sh.mods.import_poll() -> state, changed` | Menu scripts: every frame of the import page; scans a picked or dropped folder or .zip. state is idle, picking or ready. |
| `sh.mods.import_run() -> ok, report\|error` | Menu scripts: copies the chosen mods of the pick into the mods folder (all or nothing) and lists them; new mods are switched off. |
| `sh.mods.import_scan(path) -> state` | Menu scripts: scans a folder or .zip for mods now. |
| `sh.mods.import_select(index, on) -> bool` | Menu scripts: chooses whether the found mod at index is imported; false for an invalid one. |
| `sh.mods.list() -> mods` | Menu scripts: the installed mods in the pending order, each a table with id, name, version, state, enabled and more. |
| `sh.mods.move(id, delta) -> bool` | Menu scripts: moves a mod in the pending order; a negative delta is earlier. |
| `sh.mods.reload() -> lines` | Menu scripts: reloads the files of the active mods; returns what was done. |
| `sh.mods.restart()` | Menu scripts: restarts the game; does not return on success. |
| `sh.mods.restart_pending() -> bool` | Menu scripts: the saved choice loads another set or order of mods that needs a restart. |
| `sh.mods.save() -> ok[, error]` | Menu scripts: writes mods/load_order.json. |
| `sh.mods.set_enabled(id, on) -> bool` | Menu scripts: changes the pending choice; enabling also enables required dependencies. |

## sh.render

Screen effects and panels an event script draws.

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.render.background{texture}` | Fills the screen with the named picture this frame. |
| `sh.render.display_init{width = 320, interlaced = false}` | Sets the display up again (width 256, 320, 368, 512 or 640). |
| `sh.render.display_swap()` | Swaps the display buffers now. |
| `sh.render.fade_in_level() -> q12` | How far the screen has faded in: 4096 fully shown, 0 black. |
| `sh.render.frame_hold{source, tint, blend, layer, offset}` | Draws a frame over the new one for this tick: source "previous" (a trail), "held" or "current"; blend none, half, add, sub or quarter. |
| `sh.render.held_capture()` | Copies the frame at the end of the world pass into the held picture. |
| `sh.render.held_clear()` | Makes the held picture black. |
| `sh.render.panel(ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, u0, v0, u1, v1, shade, page, palette_x, palette_y, blend, split) -> panels` | Draws an upright textured rectangle in the world from corner a (top) to corner b (bottom), in geometry units from the panel view. |
| `sh.render.panel_view(x, y, z)` | Sets the world point (Q12) the panels drawn after it are relative to. |
| `sh.render.picture_screen(on)` | PC: the frames are a flat full-screen picture (4:3 with black side bars). |
| `sh.render.sprite{texture, rect, uv, tint, blend, layer} or {texture, uv, sprites = {...}}` | Draws rectangles 1:1 from a named texture ("background"); up to 64 per call. |
| `sh.render.texture_load{file, texture, buffer}` | Loads a TIM picture into a named texture ("background", "paper_map"); wait with sh.load.wait(). |
| `sh.render.tile{rect, colour, blend, layer, tpage, dither}` | A rectangle of one colour; rect = {x, y, w, h} from the screen's centre. |
| `sh.render.vblank_interval(n)` | Makes a frame last at least n vertical blanks (1..8). |
| `sh.render.vram_restore{rect = {x, y, w, h}, buffer}` | Copies a backup buffer back into the video memory. |
| `sh.render.vram_save{rect = {x, y, w, h}, buffer}` | Copies a part of the video memory into a backup buffer. |
| `sh.render.world_quads{points, quads, texture, blend, depth_bias, clip} -> count` | Textured quads in the world from an effect slot's draw hook; points are x, y, z in Q12. |
| `sh.render.world_redirect{layers = {{offset, tint, blend}, ...}}` | This frame the world is drawn into the held picture and shown as 1..8 layers. |

Not described yet: `sh.render.ambient_light(...)`, `sh.render.flat_light(...)`, `sh.render.light_mode(...)`, `sh.render.ui_draw_mode(...)`, `sh.render.ui_frame(...)`, `sh.render.ui_gouraud(...)`.

| `sh.world.object_draw(name, x, y, z, rx, ry, rz)` | Draws a "script" world object once more this tick at another place. |
| `sh.world.object_model_name_set(name, model)` | Gives a world object another model. |
| `sh.world.pickup_create{item, x, y, z, rot, id, flag, count, message, model, units} -> id or nil, err` | Puts a real pickup on the loaded map; flag (from the mod's flags.json) marks it taken. Call it at every map load. |
| `sh.world.pickup_remove(id) -> bool` | Removes a pickup the script created. |
| `sh.world.pickups([units]) -> rows` | The script pickups of the map: {id, owner, item, model, flag, count, message, x, y, z, rot, taken}. |
| `sh.world.ray(fx, fy, fz, tx, ty, tz[, mode[, exclude_slot]])` | Casts a ray; mode is "solid", "chara", "sight" or "probe"; slot is -1 when it hit geometry. |
| `sh.world.ray_surface(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1)` | Casts a ray against the collision surface. |
| `sh.world.script_call(name, a, b, c) -> 1 or 0` | Calls a global function of the map's world_objects.lua. |
| `sh.world.speed_zone(x, z)` | The speed zone of a point: 0 slow, 1 normal, 2 fast. |
| `sh.world.walkable(x, z[, from_x, from_z]) -> ok, ground_y` | Whether the point has loaded ground; with from, also whether it can be walked to from there (height step and walls). |
| `sh.world.water_disable(...)` | Turns the water effect off. |
| `sh.world.water_enable(...)` | Turns the water effect on. |

Not described yet: `sh.world.collision_groups()`, `sh.world.effects_reset(...)`, `sh.world.effects_update(...)`, `sh.world.surface_get(...)`.

## sh.world_object

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.world_object.model_set(name, model)` | Changes the model of a world object (a name of up to 8 characters). |
| `sh.world_object.position_get(name) -> x, y, z` | The position of any world object of the map. |
| `sh.world_object.position_set(name, x, y, z)` | Moves a world object of world_objects.json (one with "script": true), Q12. |
| `sh.world_object.rotation_get(name) -> x, y, z` | The rotation of any world object of the map. |
| `sh.world_object.rotation_set(name, x, y, z)` | Turns a world object, Q12 angles kept in 16 bits. |
| `sh.world_object.visible_set(name, v)` | Shows a world object always (true), never (false) or as the map data says (nil). |

## sh.world_objects

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `sh.world_objects.call(name, a, b, c) -> 1 or 0` | Calls a global function of the map's world_objects.lua from the events script. |

## string

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `string.byte(s[, i[, j]]) -> codes` | The byte values of characters of s. |
| `string.char(...) -> string` | A string of the given byte values. |
| `string.find(s, pattern[, init[, plain]]) -> start, end` | Finds a pattern in s. |
| `string.format(fmt, ...) -> string` | Formats values printf-style. |
| `string.gmatch(s, pattern) -> iterator` | Iterates over the matches of a pattern. |
| `string.gsub(s, pattern, repl[, n]) -> string, count` | Replaces the matches of a pattern. |
| `string.len(s) -> n` | The length of s in bytes. |
| `string.lower(s) -> string` | s in lower case. |
| `string.match(s, pattern[, init]) -> captures` | The captures of the first match of a pattern. |
| `string.rep(s, n[, sep]) -> string` | s repeated n times. |
| `string.sub(s, i[, j]) -> string` | The part of s from i to j. |
| `string.upper(s) -> string` | s in upper case. |

## table

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `table.concat(t[, sep[, i[, j]]]) -> string` | Joins the strings of a list. |
| `table.insert(t, [pos,] value)` | Inserts a value at pos (default the end). |
| `table.remove(t[, pos]) -> value` | Removes and returns the element at pos (default the last). |
| `table.sort(t[, less])` | Sorts a list in place. |
| `table.unpack(t[, i[, j]]) -> ...` | The elements of a list as separate values. |
